summary: The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that are designed to provide, in the aggregate, 200% exposure to the price performance of CIFR on a daily basis. The fund may also seek to achieve its investment objective by purchasing call options on CIFR or by investing directly in the common stock of CIFR. The fund is non-diversified.
